name: Smooth AI Consultancy

logo.mark: brand/logo-mark.svg (Heritage Stroke): ink rounded square rx=11 with one paper S stroke, 5.6 width on 48 grid, round caps. Single source; nav tile, favicon, and reply wrapper draw from it.
logo.email_rule: No image logo in cold email (spam weight). Wordmark in text: 'Smooth AI Consultancy'. Mark appears once at 40px in the reply-stage HTML wrapper only.

voice: We/us founder voice, never third-person corporate
No deck. We look at your actual workflow, not a template.
If we are wrong for you, we say so in that call, not after an invoice.
You keep the notes even if you never hire us.
Honest payback, argued assumptions, walk away if the math fails
banned: Em dashes in email body (hard rule in cold_outreach outreach agent)
Three-item hype lists and balanced clause pairs
'I hope this finds you well' / 'I wanted to reach out'
Links, meeting requests, or booking CTAs in cold openers
Claims the audit record cannot source
